title: Collect comments in one paste
description: Quote a selection, add a comment, and keep reading.
body: The Hammerspoon module binds Option+C to a small comment box. Each note keeps its selected passage. The clipboard accumulates them so the whole set can go into one message.

title: Pacing calls in five-minute blocks
description: A floating Mac clock with a ring that fills once every five minutes.
body: I built a small clock that stays above a call window. The ring shows progress through the current five-minute block and the counter shows how many blocks have passed.

title: Ask for technical options you can understand
description: A coaching habit for comparing implementation options.
body: And then I think one thing that's like very important is like figuring out a way of like asking the AI to like give you technical options in a language that you understand.

title: Let the model interview you
description: A way to begin when the task is hard to specify.
body: Or sometimes just having a conversation of like, I don't know exactly how to specify this task. Can you kind of like ask me questions?

title: Let the model suggest a starting point
description: How I start in a field I don’t know well.
body: And so for the things where you're not a world expert or where you don't have like a bunch of context, it's like very useful to just like let it start by suggesting things for you.

title: Who wants another session?
description: One question I use when deciding where coaching would help.
body: You have to figure out who's eager to work with you further.

title: Change the interview as you learn
description: Why I keep revising the interview questions in a workflow audit.
body: And if you have like 20 calls, there's like enough space that you can iterate and find your way through.
